title: CORN! CORN! KING! // 24/7 ELDRITCH BROADCAST
narrative: The big black raven lands on the kettle in the Old Bear's solar. 'CORN!' it screams. 'CORN! SUBSCRIBE TO MY SUBSTACK! KING! MERCH LINK IN BIO!' Beneath the roots beyond the Wall, Brynden Rivers adjusts his micro-weirwood headphones. 'Hello listeners, welcome back to episode 4,118 of The Eye in the Tree. Today we analyze why Jon Snow refuses to brush his hair, followed by an ad read for Valyrian steel whetstones.'
